name: Breakthrough T1D Postdoctoral Fellowship (formerly JDRF)
amount: Stipend by years of postdoc experience + USD 5,500/year research allowance
other_rules: MD, DMD, DVM, PhD or equivalent received no more than 5 years before application (adjustable for leave)
at least 75% effort on the project
not concurrently in internship or residency
notes: Type 1 diabetes research. Deadlines are posted on the Breakthrough T1D grant opportunities page (not found for FY27). Renewable for up to 2 more years. An Advanced Postdoctoral Fellowship exists for later-stage postdocs.
